edges.reason: mint requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mint reads pixxoPrice to validate the required Ether amount.
mint forwards msg.sender as the recipient of newly minted tokens.
mint loops calling _mintPixxo for each requested NFT.
mint enforces n <= MAX_MINTS_PER_TX.
_mintPixxo calls nextToken to obtain the token id.
_mintPixxo calls _safeMint which may invoke an external onERC721Received callback.
nextToken derives its randomness from block.timestamp.
nextToken derives its randomness from msg.sender.
nextToken reads and writes tokenMatrix to shuffle token ids.
nextToken reaches the weak randomness unsafe operation.
claimReserve mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
claimReserve checks and updates totalReserveMint.
claimReserve compares totalReserveMint against MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
claimReserve performs a privileged reserve mint guarded by onlyOwner.
setPrice writes the new value into pixxoPrice.
setPrice consumes the _price parameter.
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
setBaseURI writes the new ipfsBase value.
setBaseURI consumes the uri parameter.
tokenURI invokes _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
tokenURI consumes the _tokenId parameter.
_baseURI returns ipfsBase.
External onERC721Received callback during safe mint can re-enter the mint flow.
mint loop bound and payment depend on parameter n.
_mintPixxo uses parameter to as the mint recipient.
_mintPixxo stores nextToken result in local mintIndex before minting.
nextToken computes maxIndex from maxSupply and totalSupply.
nextToken assigns the weak-random value to local random.
nextToken selects the returned token id via local offset.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter n exclusively drives the mint loop and payment validation.
Parameter _price is only used to update pixxoPrice inside setPrice.
Parameter uri is only used to update ipfsBase inside setBaseURI.
Parameter _tokenId is only consumed by tokenURI for URI construction.
Parameter to is only used as recipient inside _mintPixxo.
Local mintIndex directly feeds the _safeMint unsafe operation.
Local maxIndex is computed and used only within nextToken.
Local random holds the weak-randomness result built by the unsafe operation.
Local offset is produced by the same weak-randomness shuffle logic.
